_notes: 8 fictional job descriptions for seeding the demo account. Each jd_text uses 'Requirements:' and 'Nice to have:' headings so the extractor can split required vs nice-to-have skills. Companies are invented.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
jobs.jd_text:
Quillstack builds collaborative writing tools for small teams. We're hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to own features end to end, from database schema to polished UI.

What you'll do:
- Ship customer-facing features across our Next.js frontend and Node.js services
- Design REST APIs and evolve our PostgreSQL data model
- Partner with design in Figma and raise the bar on accessibility
- Mentor mid-level engineers through code review

Requirements:
- 5+ years of professional software engineering experience
- Strong TypeScript and React
- Node.js and REST APIs in production
- PostgreSQL and solid SQL
- Testing discipline (Jest or Vitest)
- Experience deploying on AWS

Nice to have:
- Next.js App Router
- Tailwind CSS
- GraphQL
- CI/CD with GitHub Actions

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.jd_text:
Cobalt Freight moves 40,000 shipments a day. Our platform team builds the paved road every product engineer uses.

What you'll do:
- Set technical direction for our Kubernetes-based internal developer platform
- Own infrastructure as code across multiple AWS accounts
- Define SLOs and lead incident response improvements
- Influence system design across 12 product teams

Requirements:
- 10+ years of engineering experience, 3+ at staff level or equivalent
- Deep Kubernetes and Helm experience
- Terraform at scale
- Go or Python for tooling
- AWS networking and IAM
- Observability with Prometheus and Grafana

Nice to have:
- Kafka
- Security and SOC 2 experience
- Mentoring senior engineers

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.jd_text:
Harborline Health connects patients with in-network specialists. We're looking for a Senior TPM to drive our cloud migration program.

What you'll do:
- Run a multi-quarter program across 6 engineering teams
- Own the roadmap, dependency management and RAID log
- Report status to executives and manage stakeholders across product, security and compliance
- Facilitate Agile ceremonies and drive delivery in Jira

Requirements:
- 7+ years of technical program management experience
- Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
- Agile delivery using Scrum or Kanban
- Risk management for complex programs
- Working knowledge of AWS cloud architecture

Nice to have:
- Healthcare or HIPAA experience
- Budgeting and headcount planning
- Hands-on background with CI/CD or Docker

jobs.title: Frontend Developer I
jobs.jd_text:
Tidewater Payroll makes paying hourly workers simple. Join our frontend team as an early-career developer.

What you'll do:
- Build UI components in React with our design system
- Fix bugs and write unit tests
- Pair with senior engineers and learn our release process

Requirements:
- 0-2 years of professional experience (bootcamp grads welcome)
- JavaScript, HTML and CSS fundamentals
- Some experience with React
- Familiarity with Git

Nice to have:
- TypeScript
- Accessibility awareness
- Redux

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.jd_text:
Northwind Ledger provides real-time accounting analytics for mid-market finance teams.

What you'll do:
- Build and own batch and streaming data pipelines
- Model our warehouse for analytics and finance reporting
- Improve data quality and pipeline reliability

Requirements:
- 5+ years in data engineering
- Python and advanced SQL
- Spark or PySpark at scale
- Airflow orchestration
- Snowflake and dbt
- Dimensional data modeling

Nice to have:
- Kafka streaming
- Scala
- Tableau
- AWS S3 data lakes

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer, GenAI
jobs.jd_text:
Brightlane Learning builds AI tutors for working adults returning to school.

What you'll do:
- Ship LLM-powered features, from prompt design to evaluation
- Build retrieval-augmented generation pipelines over course content
- Productionize models with solid MLOps practices

Requirements:
- 5+ years of software engineering, 2+ in machine learning
- Python and FastAPI
- Hands-on with LLMs and RAG
- LangChain or LangGraph
- Model deployment on AWS or GCP

Nice to have:
- PyTorch
- NLP background
- TypeScript and React for internal tools
- Docker

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.jd_text:
Pinecrest Insurance is modernizing its policy platform and needs a DevOps Engineer to speed up delivery.

What you'll do:
- Build CI/CD pipelines for 30+ services
- Containerize legacy apps and move them to the cloud
- Improve monitoring and on-call tooling

Requirements:
- 3+ years in DevOps or SRE roles
- Docker and containerization
- CI/CD with Jenkins or GitHub Actions
- AWS core services
- Linux and Bash scripting
- Terraform

Nice to have:
- Kubernetes
- Node.js or Python for automation
- Observability tooling such as Datadog

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Web Platform
jobs.jd_text:
Lumen Grid Energy helps households track and cut their energy use. Lead the team that owns our customer web app.

What you'll do:
- Manage and grow a team of 7 engineers
- Own the roadmap with product and design
- Keep a hand in architecture and code review

Requirements:
- 8+ years of software engineering, 2+ managing engineers
- Hiring and mentoring experience
- Strong background in React and TypeScript
- System design for web applications
- Agile delivery and stakeholder management

Nice to have:
- Next.js
- GraphQL
- Budgeting and headcount planning
- AWS
